Only confirmed effective dates and remaining charges count. Unknown facts need checking.
en.warranty_unknown: Coverage end is unknown. Check the start date and term.
en.proof_pending: Proof is stored. Resending it in chat is not supported yet.
en.proof_unknown: Proof is unknown. Send the receipt or warranty document to store it.
en.proof_missing: The saved proof is missing or failed verification. Please check it.
en.edit_prompt: Tell me what to correct. Only supplied facts will change.
en.reminder_prompt: How many days before, and at what time? Defaults: 7 days before cancellation cutoff / 30 days before end or renewal, at 09:00. You can turn it off.
en.yearly_reminder: Your {name} subscription renews on {date}. You’ll be charged {amount} won. If you want to keep using it, you can leave it as it is.

ko.yearly_reminder: {name} 구독이 {date}에 갱신돼요. {amount}원이 결제돼요. 계속 쓰실 거면 그대로 두시면 돼요.
